title: Lesson
description: An instructional content unit. The atomic learning object in the framework.

id.description: Stable identifier. Never changes after creation. Example: lesson-intro-fractions

language.description: BCP-47 language tag. Examples: en, it, de, es-419, nl-BE

owner.description: Name or role of the person responsible for this content

formality.description: Register of address toward the learner. Determines pronoun and imperative form in all target languages. Set by the content author, not the translator.

sourceLanguage.description: BCP-47 tag of the language this was adapted from. Omit if this is the source.

sourceId.description: ID of the source lesson this was adapted from

objective.description: What the learner will be able to do after this lesson. One sentence, action-verb first.

alt.description: Required when blockType is image. Describe the image for screen readers and non-visual contexts.

keyTerms.description: Terms that must not be paraphrased in translation. Used across lessons, questions, feedback and UI labels — define once here, reference by term name elsewhere.

culturalNotes.description: Notes for translators and reviewers: cultural context of examples used, tone intent, scenarios that may need adaptation. Not shown to learners.

localizationFlags.description: Required on every content item. Signals content adaptability before translation begins.

textDirection.description: Text direction of the source content. Do not assume ltr. Default: ltr for Latin-script sources.

culturalReadinessScore.description: Assigned after completing the universal checklist. Sum of five category scores (0–2 each). Required before content can advance to cultural-review stage.

localeReadiness.description: Per-locale review results. Separate from the source readiness score — a content item can be source-ready but still require full rewrite for a specific locale.

content.objective: Identify the numerator and denominator of a simple fraction.

body.value: A fraction represents a part of a whole.

body.alt: A circle divided into 4 equal parts with 1 part shaded, labelled 1/4.
body.caption: One quarter of a whole

body.value: If you cut a pizza into 4 slices and eat 1, you have eaten 1/4 of the pizza.

keyTerms.definition: The top number in a fraction. Tells how many parts we have.
The bottom number in a fraction. Tells how many parts in total.

content.culturalNotes: Pizza example is appropriate for IT/EN contexts. For DE/NL consider a bread or Kuchen example. The fraction diagram relies on colour contrast — verify accessibility before adapting.

localeReadiness.notes: Pizza example retained. Formality: tu register confirmed for this platform.
